markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 过去进行时说的是**过去某一刻「正在做」**的事。像给过去拍一张照片：那一刻你在干嘛？公式：**was / were + 动词 ing。**

uses.zh: 过去某个时间点正在做
uses.en: <<At ten last night>>, I [[was fixing]] a bug.
uses.en_zh: 昨晚十点，我正在修 bug。

uses.zh: 正在做的时候，突然发生了另一件事
uses.en: I [[was having]] lunch <<when>> the server went down.
uses.en_zh: 我正吃着午饭，服务器挂了。

uses.en: <<While>> I [[was coding]], my cat [[was sleeping]] on the desk.
uses.en_zh: 我写代码的时候，猫在桌上睡觉。

positive.title: 肯定句
positive.rule: I 和他她它用 was，你、我们、他们用 were。后面的动词加 ing。就是把现在进行时的 be **换成过去的样子**。

examples.en: I [[was waiting]] for the bus <<at eight o'clock>>.
examples.zh: 八点的时候我在等公交。

examples.en: The team [[was testing]] the app <<all afternoon>>.
examples.zh: 团队整个下午都在测 App。

examples.en: They [[were talking]] about the release <<when>> I walked in.
examples.zh: 我进去的时候，他们正在聊发布的事。

negq.title: 否定和疑问
negq.rule: 否定：在 was / were 后面加 not。疑问：把 was / were 搬到最前面。动词一直是 ing。

examples.zh: 我打电话时你在睡觉吗？

table.title: 一张表看全
table.tip: 只要记住一件事：I 和他她它用 was，其他用 were。后面的 working 一直不变。

interrupt.title: when 和 while：被打断
interrupt.text: 一件**长**的事正在进行，一件**短**的事突然插进来。口诀：**长的用进行时，短的用一般过去时。**

items.rule: 长的事 + when + 短的事
items.en: I [[was walking]] home <<when>> it [[started]] to rain.
items.zh: 我正走在回家路上，突然下起雨来。

items.rule: while + 长的事，再说短的事
items.en: <<While>> we [[were having]] the meeting, the fire alarm [[went]] off.
items.zh: 我们正在开会，火警响了。

items.rule: 两件长的事同时进行，两边都用进行时
items.en: <<While>> I [[was cooking]], my flatmate [[was doing]] the washing-up.
items.zh: 我做饭的时候，室友在洗碗。

notes: 小窍门：when 后面常跟短的事，while 后面常跟长的事。

story.title: 讲故事先搭背景
story.text: 讲故事时，先用过去进行时**搭背景**（天气怎样、大家在干嘛），再用一般过去时说**发生了什么**。

examples.en: It [[was raining]] and everyone [[was working]] quietly. Then the lights [[went]] out.
examples.zh: 外面在下雨，大家都在安静地干活。然后灯突然灭了。

examples.en: The sun [[was shining]] and we [[were sitting]] in the garden. Suddenly my phone [[rang]].
examples.zh: 阳光很好，我们坐在花园里。突然我的手机响了。

this.meaning: 老板到的那一刻，我正在吃
this.en: <<When>> the boss arrived, I [[was having]] lunch.

commonMistakes.bad: She ~~was cook~~ when I got home.
commonMistakes.good: She [[was cooking]] when I got home.
commonMistakes.why: was 后面的动词要加 ing。

commonMistakes.bad: I was sleeping when the phone ~~was ringing~~.
commonMistakes.why: 突然发生的短动作用一般过去时。
进行时用 was / were 来问，不用 did。
know 是状态，不用进行时。

quiz.explain: 过去那一刻正在做：I [[was watching]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：昨晚十点我正在修 bug。
quiz.answer: I was fixing a bug at ten last night.
accept: At ten last night, I was fixing a bug.
At ten last night I was fixing a bug.
I was fixing a bug at 10 last night.
At 10 last night, I was fixing a bug.
At 10 last night I was fixing a bug.
quiz.explain: <<at ten last night>> 那一刻正在修：I [[was fixing]]。

quiz.prompt: They ___ (talk) about the bug when I walked in.

quiz.explain: my phone 是「它」，用 was：[[was charging]]。

traps.note: 过去进行时在 was 后面加 not，不用 didn't。

quiz.prompt: 改成一般疑问句：They were working late.
针对划线部分提问：I was reviewing the code at 3 pm.（问对方「在做什么」）
quiz.answer: What were you doing at 3 pm?

traps.input: What did you doing at 3 pm?
traps.note: 进行时用 were 来问，不用 did。

quiz.explain: What [[were]] you [[doing]]？疑问词 + were + 主语 + 动词 ing。

quiz.prompt: We ___ for the train when it started to snow.
— Was Tom working at the weekend? — No, he ___.
quiz.explain: 用 was 问，就用 [[wasn't]] 答。

quiz.prompt: I was walking home when it ___ (start) to rain.
quiz.explain: 突然插进来的短动作用一般过去时：[[started]]。

quiz.prompt: While we ___ the meeting, the fire alarm went off.
改错：I was sleeping when the phone was ringing.
quiz.answer: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
quiz.explain: 电话响是突然发生的短动作：[[rang]]。

quiz.prompt: It was a cold night. The wind ___ (blow) and the streets were empty.
quiz.explain: 搭背景用过去进行时：The wind [[was blowing]]。

quiz.prompt: When the boss arrived, I ___ lunch, so I asked him to wait a minute.
quiz.explain: 老板到的那一刻我正在吃：[[was having]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：We was waiting for you.
改错：I was knowing the answer.
quiz.explain: know 是状态，不用进行时：I [[knew]]。

openTask.prompt: 用过去进行时说 3 句话：昨天某个时间你和同事分别在做什么。至少一句用 when 讲「正在做的时候突然发生了什么」。
rules: 过去进行时 = was / were + 动词 ing
I / he / she / it 用 was，you / we / they 用 were
when 后面突然发生的短动作用一般过去时
openTask.note: 规则判 was / were + ing 和 when 的用法（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
